title: Amethyst Network
description:
A fun and balanced Java SMP with custom rewards, events, and a welcoming community.

A community-focused Java SMP featuring crates, gems, and quality-of-life enhancements.

A fair and friendly SMP server with custom features, rewards, and events.
body:
Welcome to The Amethyst Network

The Amethyst Network is a friendly and balanced Java SMP server designed to provide a fun and fair experience for all players.

Features:
- Crates and rewards system
- Level-up progression
- Playtime and event rewards
- Gems currency earned from voting and events, used for cosmetics and perks

Gameplay:
This server offers a mostly vanilla survival experience with quality-of-life improvements, including:
- Silk Spawners
- Keep Inventory
- Balanced mechanics
- A safe and family-friendly environment

About:
Our goal is to build a welcoming community where players can enjoy survival Minecraft, progress fairly, and have fun together.

Server Information:
- Version: Java Edition
- IP: AmethystNetwork.net


Community:
